title: 13 吞草鼠与飞雾蟒兽14 炼器
content_zh:
如果吞草鼠知道洛豪已经把食修草给清除干净了，就不会准备来到这里了。
飞雾蟒兽一心只想吃掉吞草鼠，并没有在意吞草鼠的逃跑路线。
等到这两个灵兽出现在洛豪的神识范围中，洛豪的脸色忽然变得十分难看，就算是他也不一定能够应付结真后期的飞雾蟒兽，所以来不及收集剩下的食修草。
洛豪转身施展神识遁，就准备离开这片食修草地。
洛豪的速度不可谓不快，但是没想到正当他要转身逃走的时候，一个血盆大口，獠牙是如此的可怕，还不停的掉落着毒液，忽然笼罩了洛豪的周围，让洛豪无处可逃。
洛豪不用多想就知道这是另一只结真后期的飞雾蟒兽，来不及多想，洛豪全力施展神识遁，险而又险的避开了飞雾蟒兽的血盆大口。
一刹那间，天地风云仿佛变色了一般，飞雾蟒兽的速度非常的快，就在几个呼吸间，就闭上了血盆大口。
毒液掉在了地上，竟然把食修草也给腐蚀掉了一部分，洛豪见此情景，根本不敢与这条飞雾蟒兽战斗，全力施展神识遁，想要逃出飞雾蟒兽的攻击范围。
飞雾蟒兽扑了一个空，反而气势更胜，再次张开血盆大口，席卷向了洛豪，洛豪又一次避开了飞雾蟒兽的攻击。
飞雾蟒兽的双眼死死的盯着洛豪，同时尾巴也不停的摆动着，防止洛豪逃走，就在洛豪想要逃走的那一瞬间，它的蛇尾就像一条巨大的鞭子一般横扫而来，让洛豪不得不停了下来。
然而就在洛豪停下来的一瞬间，飞雾蟒兽仿佛一定要吃到洛豪一般，又一次张开血盆大口，向洛豪攻击而来。
洛豪开始愤怒了，长刀一挥，一道数丈长的刀幕犹如一堵墙一般，挡在了飞雾蟒兽身前，洛豪毫不保留的施展了浮沉刀。
只听砰的一声，飞雾蟒兽咬到了刀幕上，就好像咬中一块坚硬的大石头一般，始终也要不开洛豪的浮沉刀所形成的刀幕。
但飞雾蟒兽的獠牙却十分的坚硬，在刀幕的席卷下，竟然没有断掉。
而且毒液滴在了刀幕上，刀幕就好像被染色了一样，颜色变得鲜艳，而且还不停的散发着嗤嗤的声响，腐蚀的气息也开始飘飞起来。
这还是洛豪的浮沉刀第一次被完完全全的挡住，而且还是纯粹的使用**来挡住。
这飞雾蟒兽的獠牙的硬度已经相当于一件极品防御灵器了，洛豪自信就算是上品防御灵器也不一定能够挡得住他的浮沉刀。
从这一击，洛豪也看出来了自己不是飞雾蟒兽的对手，这或许跟他没有一个好的刀器有点关系，但最主要的还是洛豪的实力比起飞雾蟒兽来说差太远了。
灵兽不是人类修士，洛豪相信，就算他手段倍出，最多也只能和这条飞雾蟒兽打成平手，而且后面还有一条飞雾蟒兽追着吞草鼠赶来，就快要到达这里，洛豪根本就不敢恋战。
再次长刀一挥，数百道刀气油然而生，同时，洛豪还凝聚了数百道元气风刃，划向了飞雾蟒兽的巨大的身体。

一道强大的刀意形成的刀虹再次劈出，犹如激光一般，激射而出。
这一次，洛豪连续发动了三次攻击，洛豪就不相信这三次攻击不能击伤这条飞雾蟒兽，哪怕只是让这条飞雾蟒兽躲开，洛豪也有机会施展神识遁逃走。
刀虹发出闪亮的光芒，夹杂着元气风刃和数百道刀气打在飞雾蟒兽的身体上，竟然只是划开了点点的痕迹，这对飞雾蟒兽来说根本没有什么影响。
但是飞雾蟒兽还是愤怒了，身体上传来的点点疼痛也足够飞雾蟒兽生气了，飞雾蟒兽蛇尾猛然扫出，没想到飞雾蟒兽的身形虽然大，但是速度却非常的快。
洛豪甚至来不及施展浮沉刀挡住蛇尾的攻击，蛇尾就如巨大的鞭子一般到来，洛豪急忙将长刀挡在身前，只听砰的一声，洛豪感觉自己就好像被一辆巨大的石头撞击一般。
强大的力量撞在了长刀上，洛豪终于忍不住噗的一声，几口鲜血喷射而出，同时，洛豪的身影倒飞出去几百米远。
洛豪如果不是结真初期巅峰，还是结真初期的话，就是这一击也会让他重伤。
那力道太可怕了，就好像一个成年人全力使出一巴掌打向一个一岁的小孩子一般。
content_en:
If the grass-eating rat knew that Luo Hao had cleared away the food and repair grass, it would not be prepared to come here.
The flying mist python only wanted to eat the grass-eating rat and did not care about the grass-eating rat's escape route.
When these two spirit beasts appeared in the range of Luo Hao's consciousness, Luo Hao's face suddenly became very ugly. Even he might not be able to deal with the flying mist python beast in the late stage of Jie Zhen, so he had no time to collect the remaining food and repair grass.
Luo Hao turned around and used Spiritual Escape, and was about to leave this food and cultivation grassland.
Luo Hao's speed was not bad, but he didn't expect that just when he was about to turn around and escape, a bloody mouth, the fangs were so terrifying, and kept dripping venom, suddenly enveloped Luo Hao, leaving Luo Hao with nowhere to escape.
Luo Hao didn't need to think too much to know that this was another Flying Mist Python beast in the late stage of Jiuzhen. Without any time to think, Luo Hao used all his strength to escape from the Spiritual Escape and narrowly avoided the Flying Mist Python beast's bloody mouth.
In an instant, the sky and the earth seemed to change color. The flying mist python was very fast. In just a few breaths, it closed its big mouth.
The venom fell to the ground and actually corroded part of the food repair grass. Seeing this, Luo Hao didn't dare to fight the flying mist python beast. He used all his strength to escape from the flying mist python beast's attack range.
The flying mist python jumped in the air, but became even more powerful. It opened its bloody mouth again and swept towards Luo Hao. Luo Hao once again avoided the flying mist python's attack.
The Flying Mist Python's eyes were fixed on Luo Hao, and its tail kept swinging to prevent Luo Hao from escaping. The moment Luo Hao wanted to escape, its snake tail swept across like a huge whip, forcing Luo Hao to stop.
However, the moment Luo Hao stopped, the flying mist python beast opened its bloody mouth again and attacked Luo Hao, as if it was determined to eat Luo Hao.
Luo Hao became angry. He waved his long knife, and a sword curtain several feet long was like a wall, blocking the flying mist python. Luo Hao used the Floating and Sinking Knife without reservation.
With a bang, the Flying Mist Python bit the knife screen, as if it had bitten a hard stone. It could not break through the knife screen formed by Luo Hao's floating knife.
But the fangs of the Flying Mist Python were very hard, and they were not broken even under the sweep of the sword curtain.
Moreover, when the venom dripped on the blade curtain, the blade curtain seemed to be dyed, the color became brighter, and it kept making a hissing sound, and the corrosive breath also began to fly.
This is the first time that Luo Hao's floating knife has been completely blocked, and it was purely using a gun to block it.
The hardness of the fangs of this flying mist python is equivalent to that of a top-grade defensive weapon. Luo Hao is confident that even a top-grade defensive weapon may not be able to block his floating knife.
From this blow, Luo Hao also saw that he was no match for the Flying Mist Python Beast. This may have something to do with the fact that he did not have a good knife, but the most important thing was that Luo Hao's strength was far behind the Flying Mist Python Beast.
The spirit beast is not a human monk. Luo Hao believes that even if he tries his best, he can only draw a tie with this flying mist python. Moreover, there is a flying mist python chasing the grass-eating rat behind, and it is almost here. Luo Hao doesn't dare to fight at all.
With another wave of the long sword, hundreds of sword energy emerged spontaneously. At the same time, Luo Hao also condensed hundreds of energy wind blades and slashed towards the huge body of the flying mist python.
A sword rainbow formed by a powerful sword intent struck out again, shooting out like a laser.
This time, Luo Hao launched three attacks in a row. Luo Hao did not believe that these three attacks could not hurt the flying mist python. Even if the flying mist python was just allowed to dodge, Luo Hao would still have a chance to use his divine escape to escape.
The sword rainbow emits a shining light, mixed with the vitality wind blade and hundreds of sword energy, hitting the body of the flying mist python.However, it only scratched out a few traces, which had no impact on the flying mist python at all.
But the Flying Mist Python was still angry, and the little pain from its body was enough to make the Flying Mist Python angry. The Flying Mist Python's tail suddenly swept out. Unexpectedly, although the Flying Mist Python was big, it was very fast.
Luo Hao didn't even have time to use the floating knife to block the attack of the snake tail. The snake tail came like a huge whip. Luo Hao hurriedly blocked the long knife in front of him. He only heard a bang and Luo Hao felt as if he was hit by a huge stone.
The powerful force hit the long knife, and Luo Hao finally couldn't help but make a pop sound, and a few mouthfuls of blood spurted out. At the same time, Luo Hao's figure flew several hundred meters away.
If Luo Hao was not at the peak of the early stage of Jie Zhen, or still in the early stage of Jie Zhen, even this blow would seriously injure him.
The force was so terrifying, it was as if an adult slapped a one-year-old child with all his strength.
